title: Noetherian smooth section component is stable under generalization
statement: Under a smooth quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism to a noetherian scheme, the locus of points lying in the connected component of the section in their fibre is stable under generalization.

proof.text: Choose the locus to be exactly the displayed fibrewise component predicate. To prove generalization stability, let y specialize to x with x in this locus. The equality case is immediate. Otherwise P is locally noetherian because g is locally of finite type over the noetherian T. Trace y→x by a DVR morphism a:Spec R→P.

Base change g along a≫g. The original section gives σ′ and a gives the tautological second section τ. The section identities and projection equalities follow from pullback.lift_fst and pullback.lift_snd. The special point of τ belongs to the component of σ′ by the existing cartesian section-component equality (Tag 055M), evaluated at that point.
Apply the two-section comparison over the trait to get component membership of τ at the zero prime.

Map that connected component by pullback.fst. Its image is preconnected, contains the original section point over g(y), contains y, and lies in g inverse image {g(y)} by pullback.condition. Mathlib ContinuousOn.image_connectedComponentIn_subset and connectedComponentIn_mono give the required membership. This proves stability of the explicitly constructed locus.
